part.text:
Fixed ACL command-rule compaction in `src/acl.c`.

When removing a rule moves later rules into its place, the scan now resumes at the replacement text instead of advancing through stale memory. This ensures all now-redundant subcommand rules are removed when a parent command permission is subsequently granted.

Verified in the container:
- Reproduced the reported sequence: `ACL LIST` now shows `-@all +config`, without `-config|set`.
- Ran `./runtest --single unit/acl`: all tests passed.
